title: ai-kit commit fold
description: Starts each unit and runs its boundary step, folds each finished plan after every wave, and points GSD's ship at the unit flow.

fragment.inline: ai-kit unit flow (boundary before planning): before anything else, run node .claude/gsd-core/bin/gsd-tools.cjs ai-kit-fold boundary-plan --phase <this phase's number> from the project root. It refreshes the codegraph index and the graphify graph on this branch and rewrites .aikit/brief/SKILL.md. Read that brief after the SPEC and CONTEXT; locked decisions win. If the command is missing or fails, continue and say so in your return. In every PLAN.md you write, put this line inside <objective>, because a cross-AI executor gets only the plan's objective and tasks: Unit brief: read .aikit/brief/SKILL.md after the SPEC and CONTEXT; if it is missing, says no brief, or names another unit, say so and continue.
